title: Skeptic Carl Pflock's only visit to the crash site

tellings.quote: The only skeptic that has ever been here was Carl Flock. That's because I drove him out here and walked him around and he lived two hours away.

plain: Scott Ramsey, a researcher who has spent years investigating a craft said to have crashed in 1948 in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, says only one skeptic has ever visited the site: the writer Carl Pflock. Ramsey tells Michels that happened only because he drove Pflock out himself and walked him around, though Pflock lived just two hours away. Ramsey offers this as a sign that the doubters never looked at the ground itself.
